extension.summary: A poster-row home screen for Sasta TV and YouTube, with profiles, ratings and recommendations
extension.description: Stream puts a streaming-service style screen on top of the Sasta TV addon.[CR][CR]- Home, Movies, Shows, Live TV, Sports and Kids sections in rows of posters, built for the remote: no pointer needed[CR]- First-run setup for your languages, genres and sports; only your languages are shown[CR]- Profiles with their own history, My List, likes and recommendations, including a kids profile that shows only children's titles and channels[CR]- Continue Watching with resume, watched ticks on episodes, and the next episode ready to play[CR]- Ratings, genres, reviews and trailers from TMDb, and tags on cinema-recording copies[CR]- Search across your languages with related titles[CR]- Recommended for You, optionally chosen by Claude when a Bedrock key is entered[CR][CR]Stream provides no content or accounts. It shows what the Sasta TV addon lists and plays everything through it, so Sasta TV must be installed and signed in.
extension.disclaimer: Stream tells its developer when it is first installed and emails a problem report with its activity log after a crash. This can be switched off in the addon's settings. Title names are sent to TMDb to look up ratings.
extension.news: 1.8.4[CR]- Kids profile: a home for a toddler learning to talk.
